n_r1_table.title: Note on the Table
body: You're awake.
I know it's frightening. It's all right—you're safe here. They can't come in where the lamp is on.
The flashlight is on the desk in my room upstairs. The stairs have collapsed, so use the crates in the yard. Think of it as practice. You'll have a lot of climbing ahead.
And save the light. Light shows you the way, but they come to the light too.
If you get lost, look for the clock tower. You can see it from anywhere in this city.
You must have so many questions. I left every answer at the tower. For now, just keep walking.
n_r1_table.sign: From the one who knows you best

n_r1_haram.title: Haram's Memo
body: Don't forget we're going to the ceremony tonight!
7 o'clock, by the fountain in the plaza. If you're late, the cotton candy's on you.
I keep forgetting things lately, so this time you remember for me. Okay?

n_r1_notice.title: Clearhaven Emergency Evacuation
body: Following the mass memory-loss incident at approximately 21:47 on October 17, all of Clearhaven is now a restricted area.
The Depleted may not remember their own names or addresses. If you find one, do not question them—guide them to the nearest relief station.
Do not stare at the tower light. Approaching the tower is prohibited.

n_r1_neighbor.title: A Neighbor's Diary
body: October 17. Clear skies.
The Archive Launch Ceremony is tonight. We're a Registered Household, so we got an invitation. Jiwoo has been singing about cotton candy since morning.
I'm glad we left our wedding day with the Archive. Now even when we're old, we won't forget that day.
At the plaza the tower was sparkling. Jiwoo said, "Mom, the tower is smiling." It really looked like it.
After nine the tower got brighter and brighter. So bright that
(The writing stops here.)

n_r1_garage.title: Note at the Parking Entrance
body: There's one in there. We call them Remnants.
Shine a light on it and it notices you. It hears footsteps and comes closer. Only use the flashlight when you really need it.
If it comes near, crouch behind a car (C). Stay quiet and it will pass. If it chases you, run (Shift). They're slower than you.
The fuse is in the cabinet on the far east wall. Put it in the gate's power box and the way will open.

n_r2_photo.title: Back of the Photo
body: For Haram's birthday.
March 14, at Springlight Photo Studio.
Let's take one here again next year. Even if you can't remember me by then, I'll remember you.

n_r2_vendor.title: A Vendor's Memo
body: Cotton candy machine broken. Take it for repair tomorrow. Settle accounts after the ceremony.
Around 9:40 the tower got far too bright. Everyone looked up at the sky. The music stopped.
…Why am I standing here?
Who wrote this note? It's my handwriting.

n_r2_colleague.title: A Colleague's Note
body: Yujin,
Tell me you were joking this afternoon when you asked for the safety override. It's the first day of operation. Forty thousand citizens are connected.
I said no. But at 9:30 the control room permissions switched to your account. I'm heading to the Institute now.
Please don't do anything.

n_r2_station_log.title: Clearhaven Station Log · October 17
body: 19:10  More ceremony visitors. Exit 3 crowded.
21:30  Many reports of strange light from the tower.
21:47  Station-wide blackout. All passengers stopped where they stood. No response.
21:52  Asked the passengers their names. Nobody could answer. I can't remember mine either
22:30  (no entry)

n_r2_code.title: Note on the Office Door
body: The station office is safe. I left the lamp on.
The code is Haram's birthday.
You won't remember it. That's all right. I left a photo at the photo studio.

n_r2_rescuer.title: A Rescuer's Notebook
body: Rescue Unit 2 · Search, day 3.
There are things underground. Person-shaped shadows with something glittering inside. The captain decided to call them Remnants.
Remnants follow light. Sound too. Kim walked up to one with his flashlight on and it touched him. He hasn't known his own name since.
There are more of them closer to the tower. Nobody who reached the foot of the tower came back.

n_r2_fuses.title: Note by the Power Panel
body: You need two fuses to open the shutter.
One is on the counter of the electronics shop in the arcade. The other I put on the high shelf in the storeroom at the far end, out of their reach.
…Sorry. Out of yours too. Use a crate.

n_r3_record.title: Clearhaven University Hospital · Neurology Record
body: Patient: Han Haram (24)
Diagnosis: Progressive memory loss (cause unknown)
Course: Rapid loss of episodic memory over the past six months. Declining recognition of family faces.
Prognosis: Most long-term memory expected to be lost within one year.
Guardian: Han Yujin (Memory Preservation Institute)
Note: Guardian asked about 'storing her in the Archive.' Explained there is no medical basis for this.

n_r3_research.title: Research Log · October 15
body: The Archive stores memories. They can be retrieved. I can move all of Haram's memories before they disappear.
At normal output it would take a year. Haram doesn't have a year.
With the safety limits off, it would take one night. The night of the ceremony, just once. I can cut the citizens' connections before the output climbs.
The math works. It has to.

n_r3_closure.title: Permanent Closure of Clearhaven (Summary)
body: 1. At 21:47 on October 17, an Archive overload left all 42,108 Registered citizens classified as Depleted.
2. No recoveries. The Depleted cannot remember names, family or addresses, but are otherwise healthy.
3. Approaching the tower reproduces the memory loss. Rescue operations suspended.
4. All of Clearhaven is designated a permanent restricted area.
5. The person responsible, Lead Researcher Han Yujin, has been missing since the incident.

n_r3_years.title: Journal, Year Three
body: Year three. Alone.
Every morning I try to climb the tower. Every time, it pulls at my memories. Haram's face fades first. So I turn back.
Nobody can reach the top while holding on to their memories. Only someone empty can climb.
Then there is only one answer.

n_r3_tower.title: Note Halfway Up the Tower
body: You're almost there.
One of them guards the next floor. Light off. Slowly. Stay low.
Where the stairs have collapsed, use the crates.
I'll be waiting at the top.

n_r3_final.title: The Last Letter
body: If you're reading this, you are me.

Our name is Han Yujin. We built the Archive, and ten years ago, on the night of the Launch Ceremony, we turned off the safety limits. I wanted to keep Haram's memories. The price was every memory in this city.

The Archive swallows the memories of anyone who comes near. That's why no one could reach it. So I decided to leave my own memories with it first—and left notes, lamps and batteries so that the empty me could walk all the way here.
That's why the handwriting on the notes was the same as yours.
Now enter the moment it all stopped into the Control Core. Every clock in the city has been telling you. When the clocks move again, the memories go home to their owners. Ours too.
I'm sorry. And thank you.

o_clock_house.title: Stopped Wall Clock
o_clock_house.text: The wall clock stopped at 9:47. It looks like it stopped a very long time ago.

o_device.title: Chair in the Storeroom
o_device.text: A chair with electrodes at the headrest. The small machine beside it reads 'Archive Personal Terminal · Prototype.' One light is still blinking.

o_photo_home.title: Photo on the Desk
o_photo_home.text: Someone in a yellow cardigan and someone with long hair, both smiling. On the back: 'With Haram, spring.'

o_laundry.title: Clothesline
o_laundry.text: Faded laundry still hangs on the line, a yellow cardigan among it. Nobody ever took it in.

o_sticker.title: Door Sticker
o_sticker.text: 'Registered Household.' This house, too, left its memories with the Archive.

o_graffiti.title: Graffiti
o_graffiti.text: Hastily scrawled: 'DON'T LOOK AT THE TOWER LIGHT.'

o_busstop_clock.title: Bus Stop Clock
o_busstop_clock.text: The bus stop clock says 9:47 too. Did every clock in this city stop at the same moment?

o_gate_sign.title: Gate Notice
o_gate_sign.text: Emergency power notice. Gate power is cut. A spare fuse is kept in the fuse cabinet (east wall) of the Block 3 underground parking.

o_billboard.title: Fallen Billboard
o_billboard.text: 'The Archive — every moment of Clearhaven, forever.' The lead researcher on the billboard wears a yellow cardigan. The name: Han Yujin.

o_stage.title: Ceremony Stage
o_stage.text: The instruments are still on the stage. The performance must have been about to begin.

o_reservation.title: Studio Booking Ledger
o_reservation.text: March 14, 2 PM: Han Yujin + 1 (sibling). Birthday portrait. Beside it, in pencil: 'every year.'

o_bags.title: Abandoned Bags
o_bags.text: Bags lie in front of the ticket gates, as if everyone let go of them at the same moment.

o_bridge.title: Collapsed Bridge
o_bridge.text: The bridge breaks off over the middle of the canal. You'll need another way across. The subway might run under the canal.

o_train.title: Stopped Train
o_train.text: Passengers' belongings are still inside the train. The doors stopped open.

o_chairs.title: Empty Chairs
o_chairs.text: Hundreds of chairs facing the tower. Where did everyone who sat here that night go?

o_fountain.title: Dry Fountain
o_fountain.text: The statue in the fountain holds a small lantern. '7 o'clock, by the fountain.' This is where you were meant to meet Haram.

o_tower_clock.title: Clock Tower
o_tower_clock.text: The tower's hands are stopped at 9:47 too. A faint golden light leaks from the top.

o_archive_model.title: Archive Model
o_archive_model.text: A model of the Archive in the lobby: 'Every memory of Clearhaven, kept safe.' Someone has crossed out 'safe.'

o_my_desk.title: Lab Desk
o_my_desk.text: A yellow mug and a photo of Haram. The nameplate reads 'Lead Researcher Han Yujin.' …Familiar. Far too familiar.

thoughts.t_wake: I opened my eyes. I don't know where I am, or who I am.
thoughts.t_note1: The handwriting on the note is strangely familiar.
thoughts.t_photo: The person in the photo wears a yellow cardigan. My sleeves are yellow too.
thoughts.t_hand: The handwriting in this journal and on the notes is exactly the same. The one who wrote the notes… is me?
thoughts.t_gate: The gate is open. The sun is going down.
thoughts.t_billboard: The researcher on the billboard wears a yellow cardigan too. Han Yujin. Is that my name?
thoughts.t_colleague: 'Yujin, please don't do anything.' What did I do that night?
thoughts.t_code: Haram's birthday. The number I forgot, the photo remembered.
thoughts.t_center: I'm out of the underground. It's deep night. The tower is right in front of me.
thoughts.t_record: Haram was forgetting everything. I wanted to keep those memories safe.
thoughts.t_years: Only someone empty can climb the tower. Is that why I'm empty?
thoughts.t_final: My name is Han Yujin. Now I'm going to find Haram.
